Chapter 377 - 377 Receiving Da Mi Group; Welcome! (1)

Chapter 377 - 377 Receiving Da Mi Group; Welcome! (1)

377 Receiving Da Mi Group; Welcome! (1)

The Qiu family could not ignore the Feng family.

However, in the eyes of the old master of the Zhou family, a mere Feng family… was probably just bigger ants.

CEO Wang, CEO Zhao, CEO Liu, and Sister Qin were trembling in fear when they saw Feng Jiaqi’s miserable appearance.

At this moment, when they heard that Old Master Zhou would personally investigate this, they were even more scared out of their wits.

That was the pillar of the top-notch Zhou family!

At this moment, Qiu Kai seemed to have thought of something. He glanced at CEO Wang, CEO Zhao, CEO Liu, and Sister Qin with his sharp eyes and asked in a deep voice, “Did you offend Mr. Lin?”

When the four of them heard this, they broke out in a cold sweat, and their hair shook like rattle drums.

What a joke. Even the old man of the Zhou family was going to personally investigate this.

If they had provoked Lin Fan, the consequences would be… They were definitely not something they could bear.

“Then why did Mr. Lin come here for dinner today?” Qiu Kai asked.

Wang Zhi stammered, “M-Mr. Lin’s woman is an employee of my company.”

How smart was Qiu Kai?

With just a little thought, he knew the general process.

He swept a cold glance over and let out a muffled grunt.

Wang Zhi and Sister Qin were so frightened that they almost fell to the ground.

…

Lin Fan naturally did not know what happened in the private room and what happened afterward.

At this moment, Lin Fan and Xu Jingrou had already walked out of the Qingting Hotel.

There were wide asphalt roads and winding brick sidewalks in Jingbei…

Due to the narrow path, the two of them were very close to each other. Their shadows were almost fused together, and their fingers touched each other from time to time…

At this moment, Xu Jingrou stepped on a loose brick and fell to the side.

Lin Fan’s reaction was extremely fast. He grabbed Xu Jingrou’s slender waist.

Their eyes met.

In the next moment, the two of them seemed to be attracted to each other and kept approaching…

o(￣ε￣*)

(*￣3)(ε￣*)

…

In the eastern district of Jing City, in a sub-new residential area called Jingeyuan.

Xu Jingrou was staying in Room 2104 of Block C.

Today, the entire Block C seemed to be shaking as if there was an earthquake.

…

The next morning.

Lin Fan could vaguely hear a series of low footsteps.

He slowly opened his eyes and saw that Xu Jingrou had already changed into her business attire and was ready to leave.

“Are you awake?” Xu Jingrou said.

Lin Fan nodded. “Are you going to work?”

“Yes,” Xu Jingrou replied. She looked at her watch and said, “I have something important to do today. There’s breakfast and a spare key on the table…

“I’ll be leaving first.”

After saying that, she hurriedly walked out.

After the door was closed, the entire house fell silent.

Even though Xu Jingrou had witnessed Lin Fan’s extraordinary abilities yesterday, she still chose to go to work on time today and did not stay to accompany Lin Fan.

Regarding this…

Not only was Lin Fan not angry, but he even smiled.

If his woman wanted to be a canary…

For example, Huang Ling and Qiu Ziqian, Lin Fan would be happy to give them the best food and the most luxurious clothes.

There were also strong women like Qin Yuxuan, Han Tian, Chu Yunyue, and so on.

Lin Fan had never thought of keeping them by his side.

There was also Hu Tian, who liked math.

Lin Fan was happy to call her ‘Teacher’.

…

Everyone had their own personality and hobbies, and Lin Fan would not interfere.

Lin Fan picked up his phone out of habit.

At this moment, a text message appeared on the screen.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 7,489,000 yuan was deposited into your account.]

Lin Fan was already used to this, and his expression did not change at all.

Then, he turned his attention to the sign-in system.

“Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained 51% of Da Mi Group’s shares.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s expression changed slightly.

Da Mi Group was involved in many industries such as cell phones, television, air conditioning, and so on. Moreover, they were doing well in each industry.

Lin Fan remembered that he had used Da Mi’s phone before.

At that time, Lin Fan had to spend a long time in front of the computer before he succeeded.

The functions and price of the Da Mi phone did not disappoint Lin Fan.

Today, Da Mi Corporation’s market value had exceeded 500 billion yuan.

51% of the shares, which meant… His assets had increased by another 50 billion yuan?

Thinking of this, Lin Fan rubbed his nose.

At this moment, a gust of wind blew over from afar.

The curtains rustled in the wind, and the cabinet door that was not closed slowly opened.

In the next moment, Lin Fan was attracted by the neatly folded white bedsheets with a touch of red.

He looked at the bedsheet and thought of the first time he met Xu Jingrou. He could not help but smile.

After a while, Lin Fan slowly got up from the bed.

After he came to the living room, he picked up his chopsticks and ate the lean meat noodles on the table. He nodded and said, “It tastes good!”

After finishing the noodles, Lin Fan did not stay in the house for long. He leisurely walked downstairs.

He walked along the winding sidewalk and watched the old men in the park playing chess while quarreling. He observed the cars speeding along the road and passersby walking in a hurry.

Not long after, many tall buildings appeared in Lin Fan’s vision.

Lin Fan swept his gaze over, and it landed on the Da Mi Building.

He rubbed his nose and muttered, “I didn’t expect to accidentally walk here.”
